final: WITH lab_with_sex AS (SELECT L.*, P.SEX FROM Laboratory L INNER JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID), sex_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(SEX, '') as sex, COUNT(*) as test_count FROM lab_with_sex GROUP BY COALESCE(SEX, '')), stats AS (SELECT *, (SELECT SUM(test_count) FROM sex_counts) as total_tests, (SELECT AVG(test_count) FROM sex_counts) as avg_per_group FROM sex_counts) SELECT sex, test_count, CAST(test_count AS REAL) / total_tests as fraction_of_total, test_count - avg_per_group as above_average FROM stats WHERE test_count > avg_per_group
